props.claim: the onboarding wizard shows four steps in this order: Account type, About you, Fund it, and Review
the primary action reads "Continue →" on the first three steps and "Open account" on the final step, and a "← Back" control is available from step two onward
the stepper marks the current step and shows completed steps with a check
the Account type step is active on first load and advances to About you when the user continues with a selected product
attempting to continue from About you with empty fields keeps the user on About you and shows inline validation errors
required identity fields are first name, last name, street address, city, and state
email must be well-formed, and malformed email such as `notanemail` shows the message "Enter a valid email"
phone must contain at least 10 digits, SSN accepts exactly the last 4 digits, and ZIP must be exactly 5 digits
the calculator updates as the user types, with no submit button and no page reload
the estimate panel shows, in order, Gross income, Deductions, Taxable income, Tax liability, and Taxes withheld, then a total labelled either "Estimated refund" or "Estimated amount you owe"
standard deductions are Single $14,600, Married filing jointly $29,200, and Head of household $21,900
taxable income equals gross income minus the deduction, floored at zero
choosing "Itemized" reveals an itemized deductions input
displayed amounts use whole-dollar US currency
the Open Account page offers exactly three products: High-Yield Savings, Everyday Savings, and Money Market

product terms shown up front are High-Yield Savings 4.34% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, Everyday Savings 3.10% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, and Money Market 4.00% APY with $100 minimum opening deposit
all three savings products are fee-free and their APY and minimum opening deposit are shown before personal data is requested
High-Yield Savings is selected by default on page load, and changing the product highlights the chosen option
the bank header is present on both the Open Account page and the Calculators page
from the Calculators page, the header link to Open Account navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`
